name: Gipfelrestaurant Walmendingerhorn
kurzbeschreibung: **Peak Restaurant Walmendingerhorn in Tirol** Discover breathtaking views from the **Gipfelrestaurant Walmendingerhorn**, perched high above the **Tirol** Alps. Enjoy hearty mountain cuisine, including freshly baked **Kaiserschmarrn**, savory **Tiroler Gröstl**, and locally sourced dishes. Sip on a **Schnaps** or a warm **Glühwein** while taking in the panoramic scenery of the **Zillertal** and **Innsbruck** valley. Perfect for hikers, families, and anyone craving a taste of alpine hospitality. Open year-round—whether you're conquering the summit or simply soaking in the beauty of **Tirol**’s peaks. Tip: Reach the restaurant via the **Walmendingerhornbahn** cable car from **Fügen im Zillertal**—just 15 minutes to the top!
